experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.description: My journey from building full-stack applications and SaaS products to engineering distributed financial systems.

items.summary: Engineering enterprise financial systems within a distributed microservices platform supporting 300+ active branches across Syria.
highlights: Contributed to the development and maintenance of 20+ microservices using .NET and ABP Framework.
Designed backend services and modeled complex business domains using Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture.
Implemented core financial modules, including accounting ledgers, trading ledgers, and balance tracking.
Developed inter-service communication and automated financial workflows using RabbitMQ and Hangfire.

items.summary: Built end-to-end web applications and multi-tenant SaaS products across multiple business domains, from requirements analysis to production delivery.
highlights: Contributed to the delivery of 7+ production web applications across multiple business domains.
Designed multi-tenant SaaS architectures with tenant-specific data isolation, subscription management, and role-based access control.
Developed database schemas, REST APIs, and administrative dashboards using Laravel, Filament, and Livewire.
Integrated Stripe and Midtrans payment gateways, Firebase notifications, and third-party services.

about.title: Engineering Beyond the Code
about.introduction: For me, software engineering is more than writing code. It's about understanding complex problems, making thoughtful decisions, and building systems that remain reliable as they grow.

sections.title: How I Think
sections.description: I enjoy breaking down complex problems, understanding how systems behave under pressure, and finding practical solutions. I'm particularly interested in the challenges of concurrency, distributed systems, and data consistency.

sections.title: What Drives Me
sections.description: Curiosity keeps me learning. I like exploring new technologies, questioning architectural decisions, and turning ideas into working projects. Every experiment is an opportunity to become a better engineer.

sections.title: Beyond Engineering
sections.description: My long-term ambition is to build software products of my own. I'm interested in turning real problems into useful products, combining technical engineering with product thinking and entrepreneurship.
